title: Payment methods multiple transfers completed
description: This event occurs when a multiple transfer process is completed. Multiple transfers allow moving funds between multiple accounts in a single atomic operation.

process.title: Process status
process.description: Status of the multiple transfer process. Always `COMPLETED` when this event is emitted.

request_id.title: Request ID
request_id.description: Unique ID for the multiple transfer request

status.title: Overall status
status.description: Overall status of the multiple transfer operation. `SUCCESS` indicates all transfers were processed successfully, `FAILED` indicates at least one transfer failed.

strategy.title: Transfer strategy
strategy.description: Strategy used to execute the multiple transfers. `SWEEP` moves all available funds. `OVERDRAFT_SWEEP` moves funds from a source account to the target account to cover a negative balance in the target account, ensuring its balance is non-negative. Can be empty string if no specific strategy was used.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.description: Array of individual transfer operations executed as part of this multiple transfer request. Minimum of 2 transfers required.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.description: Individual transfer operation between two accounts

amount.title: Transfer amount
amount.description: Amount transferred in the account's currency. Can be 0 if the transfer was skipped.

tracking_id.title: Transfer tracking ID
tracking_id.description: Unique tracking ID for this individual transfer

authorization_code.title: Authorization code
authorization_code.description: Alphanumeric code generated for the transfer authorization. Only present if the transfer was processed.

response_code.title: Response code
response_code.description: Response code indicating the result of the transfer. Only present if the transfer was processed.

denial_code.title: Denial code
denial_code.description: Code indicating the reason for transfer denial. Only present if the transfer was denied.

datetime_utc.title: Transfer datetime UTC
datetime_utc.description: Date and time when the transfer was executed in the UTC-0 (RFC3339) format. Only present if the transfer was processed.

payment_datetime.title: Payment datetime
payment_datetime.description: Date and time of the payment in the UTC-0 (RFC3339) format.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Any additional information relevant to the caller

cancelled.title: Cancelled flag
cancelled.description: Indicates whether the transfer was subsequently cancelled after being approved. Happens because the entire process is atomic and in case a transfer fails, all the approved ones will be cancelled.

cancellation_tracking_id.title: Cancellation tracking ID
cancellation_tracking_id.description: Tracking ID of the cancellation operation. Only present when `cancelled` is `true`.

from.title: Source account
from.description: Account from which the funds are transferred.

account_id.title: Source account ID
account_id.description: Pismo ID of the source account

processing_code.title: Processing code
processing_code.description: Processing code used for the source account operation

validation_results.title: Validation results
validation_results.description: All executed validations with details for each result. For a complete documentation of all possible validations, refer to Authorization validation rules for platform operations.

to.title: Destination account
to.description: Account to which the funds are transferred

account_id.title: Destination account ID
account_id.description: Pismo ID of the destination account

processing_code.title: Processing code
processing_code.description: Processing code used for the destination account operation

validation_results.title: Validation results
validation_results.description: All executed validations with details for each result. For a complete documentation of all possible validations, refer to Authorization validation rules for platform operations.

validation_result.title: Validation result
validation_result.description: Executed validation with details for its result

description.title: Description
examples: The processing code was not found.
The authorization passed flex control evaluation.
There was an internal error creating the authorization.

additional_data.title: Additional data
additional_data.description: Contains additional information that is relevant to identify how the validation was performed. Every type of validation has its own additional data.
